description: Deterministic research report generated from one P13-R recommendation packet. All value fields pass through from the packet; P13-S adds only validation, freshness, uncertainty, evidence refs and research-only status.

report_fields.policy_id: passthrough (checked against the 8 known P13-R policies)
report_fields.risk_flags: passthrough list; P13-S validation conclusions go to p13s_validation_flags, never merged here
report_fields.data_available_time: passthrough; conservative cutoff equal to decision_time in P13-R
report_fields.data_freshness_status: fresh if data_available_time <= decision_time; stale if later; missing if absent; unknown if unparseable
report_fields.missing_fields: required fields absent from the packet
report_fields.p13s_validation_flags: same list as uncertainty; P13-S-owned, never merged into risk_flags
report_fields.evidence_refs: fixed claim -> report field -> packet field -> upstream stage map

fixed_rules.unknown_policy: policy_id not in the P13-R registry
fixed_rules.generated_at: runtime metadata only; excluded from deterministic artifacts
